lines: Revenue was $752.8 million, up 37.7% year over year.
Approximately 1,043,900 tests were processed, up 22.4%; oncology volume was approximately 296,700 tests, up 57.2%, with clinical MRD units increasing by 34,000 sequentially.
Gross margin was 64.5%; GAAP net loss was $67.0 million, or $0.47 per diluted share.
Natera raised 2026 revenue guidance to $2.85-$2.91 billion and continued to expect positive cash flow.
Revenue was $23.3 million, up 27% year over year.
SOPHiA DDM processed a record 115,000 analyses, up 22%; U.S. analysis volume grew 60% and Liquid Biopsy revenue grew 80% year over year.
Reported gross margin was 64.6% and adjusted gross margin was 72.1%; IFRS net loss was $22.4 million and adjusted EBITDA loss was $8.8 million.
2026 revenue guidance was raised to $94-$96 million, with adjusted EBITDA loss guidance of $29-$32 million.
